page.notes: The marginal reference beside line one ("Ezech. 19.20.") has an overlapping mark over the chapter number, so the first figure is doubtful. Faint show-through from the reverse side appears in the margins and is left out. The text continues on the next part of the page; the paragraph is not closed here. Right margin notes are reproduced in place as note elements; the reference marks f and g are marked in the text. The "Pō-" of "Pontificij" is partly obscured and read as Pō- with some uncertainty; the mark over the vowel is uncertain.
